snippet.title: Totally Accurate Battlegrounds Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game at http://totallyaccuratebattlegrounds.se

FAQ: 
Why are you making another game? Shouldn't you be working on TABS?


We didn’t take much time away from TABS, we took two months for TABG because we wanted to bring you something while you wait for TABS. We knew that TABZ last year, and Supertruck the year before was very appreciated by our community and thought we’d keep up the tradition by making yet another game for you to play.

Why are you making a battle royale game?!

TABG is an April Fools joke, we’ve done one every year since 2016. We've previously combined one of our games with another genre or game. The first year we made Supertruck, a mix between the game Superhot and Clustertruck. Last year we made TABZ which is a mix of TABS and DAY-Z. We spend an enormous amount of lunch breaks and nights playing PUBG, this is an homage to a game we love.

Why does the game cost money?? TABZ was free!

The first 100 hours after the release will be free for all and that means free forever, if you get the game before the first 100 hours end you will NOT have to pay to keep it. The 4.99$ price after the first 100 hours goes to preserving the game such as server costs etc.  The reason we could keep TABZ free is because it's a peer to peer game without server costs. Check how many hours are left at http://landfall.se/countdown

Will there be any updates to the game?

TABG was made as an April Fool’s joke and initially not meant to be updated, when it gained a big following in the first week we decided to update it anyways. Our main project Totally Accurate Battle Simulator is currently in Early Access and our priority is to finish it before updating TABG. That said we now have some develppers working on a big TABG update. The plan is to go F2P with a new game-mode an, performance fixes and map once TABS is out of Early Access. We’re currently running betas for the F2P update if you would like to try it out!
Is there going to be a mac/console version of the game?

No, we are unlikely to do a Mac version and we do not plan on doing a console port of TABG.
